dedupe_keys.name: drivendata pump it up tanzania waterpoint records labelled functional needing repair or non functional taarifa and ministry of water data

description: Pump it Up: Data Mining the Water Table is a DrivenData practice competition built on Tanzanian waterpoint data from the Taarifa waterpoints dashboard, which aggregates data from the Tanzania Ministry of Water. Contents: one record per waterpoint labelled by operating condition (functional, functional but needing repair, or non-functional), with features including total static head (amount of water available), date recorded, funder, installer, GPS altitude, longitude and latitude, waterpoint name, basin, subvillage, region, district, local government area and ward codes, population around the well, public meeting flag, who recorded and who operates the scheme, permit status, construction year, and extraction type, management and payment fields at several levels of grouping. Producer: DrivenData, with data from Taarifa (an open source platform for crowd-sourced reporting of infrastructure issues) and the Tanzania Ministry of Water. Coverage: rural waterpoints across Tanzania. Format and access: training features, labels and test features downloaded from the competition data tab after joining the competition (free account). Licence: governed by the competition's rules and terms of data use. Caveats: a learning competition with an open-ended deadline; many fields repeat the same information at different groupings, and the snapshot is not maintained as a live asset register. Simulation uses: predicting waterpoint failure for maintenance planning, reliability analysis of rural water supply assets and benchmarking asset condition models. Related records: data-siasar-rural-water-sanitation-information-system.
